Chief_Complaint.content: Numbness, tingling, and weakness of the left arm and hand
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Numbness/tingling and weakness of left arm/hand

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Approximately 2-week history of progressive numbness and tingling after starting boxing classes
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: HPI: ~2-week progressive numbness/tingling after starting boxing classes

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Symptoms began as tingling and progressed to numbness spreading from the elbow to the arm and then to the hand
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: began as tingling, progressed to numbness from elbow → arm → hand

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Tried massage and warm baths without improvement
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: tried massage and warm baths without improvement

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has been taking ibuprofen for musculoskeletal soreness
Numbness and tingling are distributed over the palmar surface of the left 2nd to 4th digits
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Distribution: palmar surface of left 2nd–4th digits

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Experiences intermittent shoulder pain associated with boxing movements
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: intermittent shoulder pain with boxing movements

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has difficulty with piano dexterity due to left-hand symptoms
Despite weakness, she can still grasp a glass with the left hand
Had a transient loss of peripheral vision in the left eye lasting about 20 minutes a few weeks ago
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: transient loss of peripheral vision in left eye lasting ~20 minutes a few weeks ago

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Had a recent viral or flu-like illness about 1 month ago with approximately 2 weeks of being unwell
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: recent viral/flu-like illness ~1 month ago with ~2 weeks of being unwell

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports that legs and walking are normal

Past_Medical_History.content: No past medical history stated; generally healthy

Family_History.content: Father has hypothyroidism and an autoimmune disease

Social_and_Family_History.content: Uses alcohol socially and recently had a heavy drinking episode

Assessment.content: Left upper limb paresthesia and weakness progressive over approximately 2 weeks with palmar sensory loss in the left 2nd to 4th digits and functional impairment
Assessment.source_text: 1. Left upper limb paresthesia and weakness — progressive over ~2 weeks; palmar sensory loss in left 2nd–4th digits with functional impairment.

Assessment.content: History of transient left monocular or peripheral visual loss lasting about 20 minutes weeks prior
Assessment.source_text: 2. Transient left monocular/peripheral visual loss x ~20 minutes (weeks prior).

Assessment.content: Recent viral illness about 1 month prior
Concern for possible demyelinating process such as multiple sclerosis requiring urgent evaluation
Assessment.source_text: 4. Concern for possible demyelinating process (e.g., multiple sclerosis) — needs urgent evaluation.

Plan_of_Care.content: Urgent neurology referral arranged with very high priority
Recommend neuroimaging including brain with or without spinal MRI and specialist assessment as per neurology
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Recommend neuroimaging (brain ± spinal MRI) and specialist assessment (per neurology)

Plan_of_Care.content: No acute steroids initiated pending diagnostic confirmation
Plan_of_Care.source_text: No acute steroids initiated pending diagnostic confirmation

Plan_of_Care.content: Discussed that steroids are used for acute demyelinating attacks
Plan_of_Care.source_text: discussed that steroids are used for acute demyelinating attacks

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient advised to attend A&E if weakness progresses to legs, vision worsens, or if severe headache, vomiting, or seizures occur
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Safety-net: attend A&E if progression of weakness to legs, worsening vision, severe headache, vomiting, seizures

Plan_of_Care.content: Symptomatic measures with ibuprofen to be continued as previously used by the patient
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Symptomatic measures continued (ibuprofen) as previously used by patient

Physical_Findings.content: No vitals or physical exam documented
Physical_Findings.source_text: No vitals or physical exam documented
